episodes.synopsis: Chris, Joy and Gizmo meet Superbook while reluctantly cleaning the attic for Chris' father. Superbook transports the children back in time, where they meet the first man and woman in the Garden of Eden.
episodes.title: How It All Began

episodes.synopsis: Chris, Joy and Gizmo meet Cain and Abel, the sons of Adam and Eve. The travelers witness a jealous Cain who kills Abel, and then gets punished.
episodes.title: My Brother's Keeper

episodes.synopsis: Superbook takes the children back in time to witness the story of Noah and the flood. During the flood, the children board Noah's ark, along with two of every living thing on earth.
episodes.title: The Flood

episodes.synopsis: The children travel to meet Abraham and his son Isaac. They witness Abraham attempting to sacrifice Isaac on an altar.
episodes.title: The Test

episodes.synopsis: The children journey to see the courtship and marriage of Rebecca and Isaac.
episodes.title: Here Comes the Bride

episodes.synopsis: The children witness the story of two brothers, Jacob and Esau. Esau sells his birthright to Jacob, but later regrets it and threatens to kill Jacob.
episodes.title: Double Trouble

episodes.synopsis: The children witness the rise to office of a young man, Joseph. The story includes Joseph's slavery in Egypt, his wisdom and revelation, and his becoming governor.
episodes.title: A Dream Come True

episodes.synopsis: The children witness the life of Moses, and his leadership of the Israelites. The travelers see many miracles, such as the parting of the Red Sea and the discovery of drinking water.
episodes.title: The Miracle Rod

episodes.synopsis: In this action-packed episode, the travelers experience the battle of Jericho, and the fall of the city walls.
episodes.title: Those Amazing Trumpets

episodes.synopsis: The children witness the victorious story of Gideon and his army defeating the Midianites by shouting and breaking pitchers with torches inside.
episodes.title: Pitchers of Fire

episodes.synopsis: The children travel back to live the story of Samson, one of the world's most powerful men. Samson gets deceived, captured, and then destroys the temple where he's held a prisoner and slave.
episodes.title: Muscleman

episodes.synopsis: The children experience the first Christmas where they meet Mary and Joseph. Mary bears a child, and King Herod attempts to kill the baby.
episodes.title: The First Christmas

episodes.synopsis: Superbook takes the children back in time to see the highlights of Jesus' life, which includes many miracles.
episodes.title: Miracles of Love

episodes.synopsis: The children experience the story of the death and resurrection of Jesus Christ.
episodes.title: The Best News Yet

episodes.synopsis: Superbook takes the children through time to ancient Israel, where they meet Naomi and Ruth. Ruth falls in love with Boaz and gets married.
episodes.title: Mother's Day

episodes.synopsis: Superbook takes Chris, Joy and Gizmo back in time to meet Job, a wealthy man of great faith.
episodes.title: The Patience of Job

episodes.synopsis: Superbook takes the children on a journey to meet Jonah. Jonah is thrown from a ship and swallowed by a giant fish. The fish them spits Jonah on the shore.
episodes.title: Big Fish and Little Fish

episodes.synopsis: Superbook takes the children back to ancient Israel where they meet Saul, Israel's first King, and see his rise to office.
episodes.title: The First King

episodes.synopsis: The children witness how David kills Goliath the giant with a slingshot. Saul then becomes jealous of David and attempts to kill David.
episodes.title: The Giant Killer

episodes.synopsis: The children experience how King Solomon came to office and how the King rules with wisdom and understanding.
episodes.title: Superbrain

episodes.synopsis: The travelers witness the story of Elijah the prophet. Elijah performs many miracles, spiritually battles the prophets of Baal on Mt. Carmel, and wins!
episodes.title: A True Prophet

episodes.synopsis: The children witness the exciting story of how Elisha, the prophet, was protected with chariots from the attacking Syrian soldiers. Elisha then leads the captive Syrian soldiers to Samaria.
episodes.title: Flaming Chariots

episodes.synopsis: The children experience the story of Daniel, who was protected by an angel in a den full of lions.
episodes.title: The Lion's Den

episodes.synopsis: The children are accused of being spies and thus captured. Rescued by Nehemiah, the children experience the battle to protect Jerusalem without completed walls.
episodes.title: Nehemiah and the Walls of Jerusalem

episodes.synopsis: The children witness the story of Queen Esther, and how she successfully intercedes for her people to the Persian King. Esther has wisdom on how an internal enemy of the King is deceiving him.
episodes.title: The Beauty Queen

episodes.synopsis: The children experience the many miracles of Paul's ministry.
episodes.title: The Mighty Convert
